The moment of inertia of the whole body about the axis perpendicular to the xy-plane through the point (2,0) is the sum of the contributions from each part. Each contribution is computed using the parallel-axis theorem: \(I = I_{\text{cm}} + m d^2\), where \(I_{\text{cm}}\) is the moment of inertia about the part's own center of mass, \(m\) is its mass, and \(d\) is the distance from its center of mass to the axis. Summing all 52 contributions yields the total moment of inertia.

After summing all contributions as fractions, the total is \(\frac{70009}{12}\) kg·m². This fraction is already in reduced form.

ANSWER: 70009/12
